items.title: Leonard Bocage Interview, 1972-03-24
items.q: Well, my little brother used to play, him and Cottrell used to play with Peter together.

ctx.x: No, he's a, wait, I called his name in a minute. Well, Cottrell. Uh. Cottrell? Hm? Not Cottrell. Yeah. Cottrell. Yeah.
Yeah. Yeah. Well, my little brother used to play, him and Cottrell used to play with Peter together.
Mm-hmm. Peter must have had a good son. Remember Lory Warnick? No, I didn't know him.
